sources.title: RFC 9147: Datagram Transport Layer Security 1.3
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: HPKE：上下文綁定與封裝負擔
related.titleEn: HPKE: context binding and encapsulation overhead
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：977與913正確，等邊界未見紀錄可通過而已見重複拒絕；未認證資料不能推進H。 交付dtls-window.csv、位元圖狀態機與跨epoch負例；不傳送任何網路資料報。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Confirm bounds 977 and 913, accept unseen boundary records and reject duplicates. Unauthenticated descriptors must never advance the highest accepted sequence. Deliver dtls-window.csv, the bitmap state machine and cross-epoch counterexamples. The experiment sends no datagrams and requires no external endpoint.
related.difference: 定義固定測試套件、接收者測試公鑰、info與AAD；以不同租戶、訊息用途及內容類型建立負例，不使用真實秘密或自創密碼演算法。
related.differenceEn: Define a fixed test suite, recipient test public key, info and AAD. Create tenant, message-purpose and content-type counterexamples using inert data and an established implementation rather than inventing cryptographic primitives.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課寬度W的含端點視窗為[H−W+1,H]；已見重複拒絕，未見且在窗內可接受。驗證標記只能在記錄認證成功後更新。 最高已認證序號H=1040，寬度W=64，兩個epoch分開維護；低界只是容量計算，不直接表示某筆紀錄一定未見。 最低窗內序號1040−64+1=977；擴窗至128後為913。接受與否仍依認證、epoch及重複位元，不能只比較數字。
info在設定時綁定應用上下文，AAD在訊息認證中綁定額外資料；本課的封裝長度與標籤長度為指定套件假設，不能推廣為所有HPKE組合。 單筆訊息明文1000位元組，封裝公鑰32位元組，AEAD標籤16位元組；暫不計序列化、傳輸標頭及重用上下文。 額外負擔(32+16)/1000×100=4.8%；明文縮至250位元組而其他固定時，負擔為19.2%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The selected inclusive window is [H−W+1,H] for width W and highest authenticated sequence H. Reject seen duplicates and allow unseen in-window records. Update seen state only after record authentication succeeds, preventing unauthenticated metadata from advancing the model. Set highest authenticated sequence H to 1040 and width W to 64. Maintain independent state for two epochs. The lower bound describes capacity, not whether a particular record has already been accepted. The lowest in-window sequence is 1040−64+1=977. Expanding to 128 moves it to 913. Admission still depends on authentication, epoch and the duplicate bit; a numerical bound alone is insufficient.

Bind application context during setup through info and message metadata through AAD. Encapsulation and authentication-tag lengths below are assumptions for the selected suite, not universal sizes for every HPKE combination or mode. For one independently encapsulated message use 1000 plaintext bytes, 32 encapsulation bytes and a 16-byte AEAD tag. Exclude serialization, transport headers and reused-context amortization so the scope of the overhead calculation remains explicit. Relative overhead is (32+16)/1000×100=4.8 percent. Reducing plaintext to 250 bytes while holding encapsulation and tag sizes fixed gives 19.2 percent; this compares added bytes with plaintext, not with total wire size.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Cedar：forbid優先與錯誤政策的診斷契約
related.titleEn: Cedar: forbid precedence and erroneous-policy diagnostics
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：977與913正確，等邊界未見紀錄可通過而已見重複拒絕；未認證資料不能推進H。 交付dtls-window.csv、位元圖狀態機與跨epoch負例；不傳送任何網路資料報。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Confirm bounds 977 and 913, accept unseen boundary records and reject duplicates. Unauthenticated descriptors must never advance the highest accepted sequence. Deliver dtls-window.csv, the bitmap state machine and cross-epoch counterexamples. The experiment sends no datagrams and requires no external endpoint.
related.difference: 建立12筆PARC請求與permit、forbid、缺屬性政策；保存引擎決策、determining policies及errors，再實作本地敏感操作有錯誤即暫緩的外層規則。
related.differenceEn: Build 12 PARC requests and permit, forbid and missing-attribute policies. Preserve the engine decision, determining policies and errors, then add a clearly separate application rule that withholds sensitive operations when diagnostics contain errors.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課寬度W的含端點視窗為[H−W+1,H]；已見重複拒絕，未見且在窗內可接受。驗證標記只能在記錄認證成功後更新。 最高已認證序號H=1040，寬度W=64，兩個epoch分開維護；低界只是容量計算，不直接表示某筆紀錄一定未見。 最低窗內序號1040−64+1=977；擴窗至128後為913。接受與否仍依認證、epoch及重複位元，不能只比較數字。
引擎略過錯誤政策不代表應用必須忽略錯誤；本課外層准入要求Allow且errors為空，將引擎語意與產品選定規則分開測試。 12筆中引擎有8筆Allow，其中2筆伴隨錯誤診斷；其他4筆Deny，固定母體並保留各政策ID。 外層准入率(8−2)/12×100=50%；修復其中一筆錯誤且引擎仍Allow後為(8−1)/12×100≈58.333%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The selected inclusive window is [H−W+1,H] for width W and highest authenticated sequence H. Reject seen duplicates and allow unseen in-window records. Update seen state only after record authentication succeeds, preventing unauthenticated metadata from advancing the model. Set highest authenticated sequence H to 1040 and width W to 64. Maintain independent state for two epochs. The lower bound describes capacity, not whether a particular record has already been accepted. The lowest in-window sequence is 1040−64+1=977. Expanding to 128 moves it to 913. Admission still depends on authentication, epoch and the duplicate bit; a numerical bound alone is insufficient.

Skipping an erroneous policy inside the engine does not require the application to ignore diagnostics. The local wrapper admits only Allow with an empty error list, testing engine semantics separately from the product decision layered above them. Of 12 requests the engine allows eight, including two with error diagnostics. Four are denied. Keep the population and policy IDs fixed so that wrapper withholding cannot be mistaken for a change in Cedar engine behavior. Wrapper admission is (8−2)/12×100=50 percent. Repairing one error while retaining its engine Allow gives (8−1)/12×100, approximately 58.333 percent; the other error still withholds the operation.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
